steps.title: Moisturizer
steps.description:
Using a good amount of moisturizer, apply it to the placements indicated on the drawing and rub it into your skin.

Let it sit for approximately 2–3 minutes.

steps.title: Concealer
steps.description:
Wipe off excess product from the applicator.

Apply concealer to the areas indicated in the drawing.

Let it sit for approximately 2–3 minutes, then gently blend with a concealer brush or beauty blender using circular patting motions.

Do not swipe.

steps.title: Blush
steps.description:
Using liquid blush, dab a small amount on the area highlighted in the drawing.

A little goes a long way.

Blend using either a beauty blender or dense brush in circular patting motions.

steps.title: Brown Eyeshadow
steps.description:
Using an eyeshadow brush, pick up brown eyeshadow and tap off excess product on the back of your hand.

Gently apply to the outer edge of the eyes and blend across the eyelid using small circular motions.

steps.title: Mascara
steps.description:
Curl the lashes.

Apply mascara to the eyelashes in layers, allowing each layer to dry slightly before adding another.

steps.title: Contour
steps.description:
Using a cream-based contour stick, draw a small amount in the areas highlighted in the drawing.

Use a contour brush to gently blend until even.

Do not swipe.

steps.title: White Tightlining
steps.description:
Using white eyeliner, gently expose the lower waterline by pulling down the lower eyelid.

Apply the eyeliner back and forth until the pigment is visible.

steps.title: Freckles
steps.description:
Following the placement shown in the illustration, apply light brown eyeshadow or a freckle product.

Gently tap to distribute the freckles.

steps.title: Lipgloss
steps.description:
Make sure there is no excess foundation or concealer on the lips.

Apply lip balm before applying lip gloss.

steps.title: Lipliner
steps.description:
Using a lip liner slightly darker than the user's natural lip shade, outline the outer edge of the lips.

Rub the lips together to soften/blend the liner.

steps.title: Setting Spray
steps.description:
Hold the setting spray approximately a forearm's length away from the face.

Close the eyes and lightly mist the face.

Allow it to dry without touching the face.
